Four killed, including three children, in Nuh road accident

A truck collided with a motorcycle on the Tauru-Nuh road in Nuh, resulting in the deaths of four people from the same family, including three children. One woman sustained serious injuries in the accident, which occurred near Delhi Darbar Hotel. Reports indicate that the truck ran over the motorcyclists. The bodies of the young girls were found on the road.
